tasks.label: Backend: index 100 docs safely
args: import os; os.chdir(os.path.join(os.getcwd(),bytes([98,97,99,107,101,110,100]).decode())); import httpx; from itertools import islice; from app.ingest import discover_pages,_request,clean_page,_chunk_id; from app.doc_sources import USER_AGENT,GOOGLE_CLOUD_HOSTS; from app.rag_chunks import split_sections; from app.rag import RagStore; store=RagStore(); client=httpx.Client(timeout=30,follow_redirects=True,headers=dict([(bytes([85,115,101,114,45,65,103,101,110,116]).decode(),USER_AGENT)])); docs=[{bytes([105,100]).decode():_chunk_id(page.url,i),bytes([116,101,120,116]).decode():chunk,bytes([116,105,116,108,101]).decode():title or page.url,bytes([117,114,108]).decode():page.url} for page in islice(discover_pages(client),100) for response in [_request(client,page.url)] if response.url.host in GOOGLE_CLOUD_HOSTS for title,content in [clean_page(response.text)] if content for i,chunk in enumerate(split_sections(title or page.url,content))]; store.add_documents(docs); client.close(); print(len(docs))
